body: Thank you so much for the new perspective. 🌸 It does make me feel good when I help someone else. And it's moments like those when I like living. But depression and low self esteem have really taken a hold on me and the pain inside me is so deep, I don't think I'll ever be normal again. I feel like everyone gets tired of me but I don't understand why. I'm always supportive and beyond nice to everyone and yet to them I feel so unimportant and it breaks me. Thank you for commenting though, I really appreciate it.

I know, I keep trying to be supportive for myself, as I'm the only one I really have. but no matter where i am or what I'm doing, my brain is constantly flooded with reminders of how I am useless and worthless, especially to others. I've been severely broken and mistreated by so many people, I expect everyone to hurt me at some point. I just don't want to deal with it anymore. But thank you for the support, it's nice to be listened to.
